sample: Exactly the same frozen 450 edits, 50 per original cell
target_selection: minimum sha256(seed,single_target,group_id,image_id), among originally reviewed positives; shared across edits and models
input: Only source modification text, edited text, reference image(s), selected target and anonymous case/image-role identifiers
task: Single-target validity of edited meaning; ADD/SUBSTITUTE must introduce a false target condition, DELETE must strictly weaken the query
uncertainty: Explicit uncertain outcome, not silently counted as a semantic rejection or excluded
limitations: This is a new single-target semantic check, not a replication of the original all-supplied-positives rule.
No semantic-axis labels, span anchors, old decisions, or other candidate edits are shown to the judge.
Necessary reference images are retained; a two-reference query receives three images total.
The target is an annotated positive; this protocol focuses on the edited condition rather than revalidating the source label.
The sample was selected from original accepted edits. Rates are conditional acceptance, not annotation accuracy.
Model responses depend on the supplied API deployment; matching model names alone do not verify upstream model identity.
